principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for both calculating the area of shapes and holding a collection of shapes. This creates a dependency between the two functionalities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a separate class for managing the collection of shapes, and have AreaCalculator focus solely on area calculations.

principle_violations.reason: The Circle and Square classes throw UnsupportedOperationExceptions when volume is called, which contradicts the expectation that all Shapes can be used interchangeably without raising exceptions.
principle_violations.suggestion: Redesign the Shape interface to separate 2D shapes (with area) from 3D shapes (with volume). Use inheritance or different interfaces to clarify intentions.

principle_violations.reason: The Main class depends directly on specific implementations of shapes and calculators, which violates the dependency inversion principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use abstractions/interfaces to minimize the dependency on specific classes and allow for easier changes in the future.

overall_feedback: 3 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
